name: The Red Crystal
summary: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea asks travelers in Auberdine to investigate a red crystal in Darkshore's eastern mountains. Hostile moonkin are multiplying nearby and seem drawn to it, and the Sentinels need to know if the formation is real.

sections.title: A Disturbing Shift in the Wilds
sections.body: Moonkin were long seen as gentle, mystical creatures bound to the wilds of Kalimdor. Now aggressive packs are multiplying along the slopes east of Auberdine. Some night elves still revere them, but Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea puts the town's safety first as the danger grows. Reports place the beasts at a single spot among the eastern peaks.

sections.title: The Eastern Mountain Anomaly
sections.body: Scouts and wanderers speak of an unnatural red crystal jutting from a rocky hillside high above Darkshore. Rumors travel easily along the fogbound coast, so Glynda wants someone to see the place firsthand. The crystal is real, and the Sentinels still need to learn why the moonkin gather there and whether it threatens the land.

faq.q: What is the red crystal in Darkshore?
faq.answer: The red crystal is a glowing formation embedded in Darkshore's eastern mountains. The Sentinels know little of its origins, but local wildlife, especially moonkin, seem drawn to it.

faq.q: Who sends you to look for the red crystal?
aliases: who gives the red crystal quest
faq.answer: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine sends you to investigate. She helps defend the settlement and wants confirmation of the reports from the eastern mountains.

faq.q: Why are moonkin behaving aggressively around the crystal?
faq.answer: Moonkin, once regarded as gentle and mystical, have grown territorial and volatile. Glynda suspects the crystal is tied to their changed behavior and growing numbers.

faq.q: Where is the red crystal located?
faq.answer: The crystal lies east of Auberdine, high on Darkshore's eastern mountain ridge, where moonkin prowl nearby.

faq.q: Is the crystal considered dangerous by the night elves?
faq.answer: Glynda is wary of the crystal. She does not know whether it is benign or sinister, but its effect on the wild beasts already concerns Auberdine's safety.

faq.q: What happens after you discover the crystal?
faq.answer: Telling Glynda that the crystal is real confirms the reports. She then seeks to learn what it is, beginning efforts to cleanse and sample it with water from Auberdine's moonwell.

angles.text: As a Kaldorei, you may find the agitated moonkin troubling; your people revere them as sacred wards of Elune and nature.
As a druid, you have close spiritual ties to moonkin and Darkshore's natural order. The crystal's disruptive pull threatens the balance you care for.
As an Alliance member, you rely on Auberdine as a key coastal port on northern Kalimdor. A threat growing unchecked in the hills could isolate the haven from the wilderness.
